Heard Shri Ravi Prakash Yadav, leraned counsel for applicant and learned A.G.A. Perused the record.

This 482 application is being filed by the applicant assailing the legality and validity of impugned order dated 16.10.2023 whereby the applicant's application u/s 311 Cr.P.C. for cross-examination of the complainant, has been declined by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.12/POCSO Court-I, Unnao in Special Session Trial No.1347 of 2021, arising out of Case Crime No.20 of 2021,
u/s 376, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station-Dahi, District Unnao.

Submission advanced by learned counsel for applicant is that Vijay Bahadur Singh has lodged the present F.I.R. u/s 376, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 POCSO Act against the applicant with the allegation that his minor daughter Ms. "N" (aged about 16 years) was missing and the applicant has committed sexual offences against her after extending threats to her.
The girl disclosed her sad saga to her parent and that is how the FIR was registered on 27.8.2021 at Police Station Dahi, District Unnao.

It has been pointed out by learned counsel for applicant that the applicant was bailed out by the Coordinate Bench of this Court while deciding Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.207 of 2022 on 26.4.2022.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.207 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
The applicant was facing prosecution u/s 376 and other allied sections I.P.C. as well as POCSO Act,
and being cognizable offences the case was committed to POCSO Court for trial and numbered as SST No.1347 of 2021.
The prosecutrix was examined as P.W.-2 on 6.7.2022 in which she has supported the prosecution case.
In her testimony she clearly stated that on false pretext of marrying her the applicant has maintained physical relationship with the girl.
Learned counsel for the applicant has asserted that during the pendency of the trial the victim has attained the majority and the applicant and the victim have got married on 24.7.2023.
The marriage certificate is annexed as Annexurre-7 to the petition.

Under the changed circumstances, where the victim has got married with the victim, the application was filed by the accused-applicant for summoning the girl u/s 311 Cr.P.C., which reads thus :
"311. Power to summon material witness, or examine person present.-

Any Court may, at any stage of any inquiry, trial or other proceeding under this Code, summon any person in attendance, though not summoned as a witness, or recall and re-examine any person already examined; and the Court shall summon and examine or recall and re-examine any such person if his evidence appears to it to be essential to the just decision of the case."
From the plain reading of aforesaid provisions of Section 311 Cr.P.C. it is clear that there should be endeavour of the court to "reach to just decision of the case".
These words are meaningful and carries weight.

when the victim herself is submitted that she is peacefully residing with the applicant as husband and wife, then in all fairness she ought to have been summoned to make her deposition in this regard.

The Court is conscious of the reason and objective behind the application moved by the applicant u/s 311 Cr.P.C., but fact remains that since the parties have already married and residing peacefully,
the Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served to prosecute the applicant who is now the husband of the victim.

Under this peculiar circumstance, the impugned order dated 16.10.2023 is hereby quashed and it is directed that the learned trial court concerned shall summon the victim to give its statement u/s 311 Cr.P.C. within next one month from today.
It is also expected from the trial court to play pragmatic role in the matter in order to maintain peace, clam and harmonious society.
With the above observation this application u/s 482 Cr.PC. is allowed.
